title: Swipe Switcher
swipe.fingers.hint: Use a finger count that no Hyprland gesture of yours already uses.
swipe.distance.hint: Lower moves the highlight faster. A full slide across a laptop touchpad is about 400.
swipe.reverse.hint: Swipe right to move the highlight left.
swipe.wrap.hint: Off: the highlight stops at the first and last window.
alttab.hint: Alt+Tab is optional and set up in your Hyprland bindings. The copied lines show previews only while an app is full screen; paste them into ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua.
status.no-access: No access to the touchpad: add your user to the input group and log in again.
status.gave-up: The touchpad reader keeps failing; see the shell log.
